newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle trade slow $105/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle trade slow $105/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow on Wednesday following the large volume of sales on Tuesday, USDA said. Prices on slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis not fully established, few near steady.
Dressed basis sales near steady. Buyer inquiry, demand and seller interest limited.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1350 lbs 64.50-65.00, few 65.50 delivered. Dressed basis - 105.00, few 104.00. ( weighted average 104.92).
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs few 65.50 delivered. Dressed basis - 105.00.
Wk To Date- 109,800 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 79,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 23,100
